best_idea: A note hit starts a sing clip whose end is decided by a timer that counts from the note, with a sustain pre-charging the timer by its length and a release that plays an end pose or returns to idle, so the pose lasts exactly as long as the player's input.
decision_why: Take the hold-then-release shape (end pose or idle, sustain pre-charge, miss doubles the hold) for clip state, keyed to the fight tick and to explicit catalogue clip fields instead of name suffixes; the damage window stays in src/fight because the hold only decides how long a pose stays on screen.
acceptance: In the browser a hero's swing pose stays on screen while attack input is held for the swing's sustain and releasing shows the end pose or returns to idle; a missed swing holds twice as long; a server test shows the hit tick is the same with the hold clip on or off.
